papers.help: The papers of one result, or every paper. BibTeX and RIS carry each paper's id here, title, authors, year, journal, DOI and abstract, for a reference manager. The CSV adds where each paper came from, where it stands, why it was excluded, who settled it, how its reviewers voted, and its points. Points are what the reviewers' answers add up to under this screening's scoring. They rank included papers and decide nothing.
papers.noneMine: You haven't voted Include on a paper yet.

votes.title: {votes, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} by {voters, plural, one {# reviewer} other {# reviewers}}
votes.help: One row for each paper a reviewer was given, with their vote, its reason and note, the answer to each criterion, and where the paper stands now. A reviewer who has yet to vote has a row too, and so has a model that couldn't read the paper. A model isn't given a paper that is only a PDF it can't read, and a reviewer added later isn't given papers settled before they joined.
votes.leftOut: Any vote the others cast on the {count, plural, one {# paper} other {# papers}} you have yet to vote on is left out, so it can't sway yours.
votes.shown: These are {shown} of the {votes, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} cast.
votes.hiddenRows: The file has a row for each vote hidden from you, without the vote.
votes.emptyRows: The file also has {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} with no vote to show, for {why}.

emptyWhy.yet: reviewers who have yet to vote
emptyWhy.finished: reviewers who had not voted when the screening was marked finished
emptyWhy.none: papers settled without a reviewer's vote

flow.title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
flow.help: The counts fill PRISMA 2020's identification and screening boxes, taken from this screening as it stands now.

record.title: The whole record
record.help: One JSON file of the whole screening, with its papers, votes, criteria, reviewers, sources, discussion and changes, and a guide to every column. A model's answers come with the passages it named. What the screening cost is left out.
